The modification addresses a bug where the request count (`rq_count`) in the plug structure was not being decremented when a request was removed from the plug list. This fix ensures that the cached request count accurately reflects the current number of requests in the plug, thereby maintaining the integrity of the request management system in the block layer. The change is directly related to the handling of requests in the plug structure, ensuring that the count is correctly updated during the removal process.
